map.输入冷却速率、温度循环幅值与材料参数，按 Coffin-Manson 公式计算热: Enter cooling rate, temperature cycle amplitude and material parameters to compute thermal fatigue life by the Coffin-Manson formula
map.Coffin–Manson：Δε_p ∝ (2N_f)^c（本工具用等效 ΔT: Coffin-Manson: delta epsilon p is proportional to (2 Nf) to the c (the tool uses equivalent delta T as a simplified substitute)
map.依据 Coffin–Manson 关系（以塑性应变幅值为自变量），本工具用等效温: Based on the Coffin-Manson relation (with plastic strain amplitude as the independent variable), this tool uses equivalent temperature amplitude delta T as a simplified substitute to quickly compare the thermal fatigue life of different rapid cooling schemes, for relative comparison only.
map.💡 Nf = C × (ΔT × k_cr)^β；k_cr 为冷却速率影响系数，: Nf = C times (delta T times k_cr) to the beta; k_cr is the cooling rate influence coefficient; rapid cooling aggravates thermal strain and shortens life
map.热疲劳主要由温度梯度引起的热应变循环导致: Thermal fatigue is mainly caused by thermal strain cycles from temperature gradients
map.冷却速率越快，表面与芯部温差越大，热应力越高: The faster the cooling rate, the larger the surface-to-core temperature difference and the higher the thermal stress
map.Coffin-Manson 公式适用于低周疲劳（Nf < 10⁵）: The Coffin-Manson formula applies to low-cycle fatigue (Nf less than 1e5)
map.标定常数 C 必须由材料热疲劳试验回归（默认 1e5 仅为量级参考），若误填疲劳: The calibration constant C must be regressed from material thermal fatigue tests (default 1e5 is only an order-of-magnitude reference); if the fatigue ductility coefficient magnitude 0.2 to 1 is mistakenly entered as C, the life will differ by several orders of magnitude
map.📚 深度解析：快冷材料热疲劳计算（Coffin-Manson 简化式）: In-depth: Rapid Cooling Material Thermal Fatigue Calculation (Coffin-Manson simplified form)
map.急冷工艺评估：由冷却速率与温差估算热疲劳寿命: Quench process evaluation: estimate thermal fatigue life from cooling rate and temperature difference
map.材料比选：对比碳钢、合金钢、铝合金、铸铁的: Material comparison: compare carbon steel, alloy steel, aluminum alloy, cast iron
map.冷却方案优化：降速或减小温差后的寿命改善量化: Cooling scheme optimization: quantify life improvement after slowing down or reducing temperature difference
map.算法：冷却速率系数 kCr = 1+0.3×log10(冷却速率+1)；等效温度: Algorithm: cooling rate coefficient kCr = 1 + 0.3 times log10(cooling rate + 1); equivalent temperature amplitude delta Teq = delta T times kCr; thermal strain amplitude = linear expansion coefficient times delta Teq; thermal fatigue life Nf = C times delta Teq to the beta (beta less than 0, C is the calibration constant regressed from tests); thermal stress is approximately linear expansion coefficient times delta T times
map.（MPa）；安全裕度 = Nf/1e5；Nf<1000 极短、<1e4 较短、<: (MPa); safety margin = Nf / 1e5; Nf less than 1000 extremely short, less than 1e4 short, less than 1e5 moderate, otherwise good. Material library: carbon steel alpha = 12e-6 / C, E = 206 GPa; alloy steel 13 / 210; aluminum alloy 23 / 70; cast iron 10 / 120.
map.例：碳钢、冷却速率 10℃/s、ΔT=300℃、β=−0.6 → kCr 1.3: Example: carbon steel, cooling rate 10 C/s, delta T = 300 C, beta = minus 0.6 gives kCr 1.3124, delta Teq 393.73 C, thermal strain amplitude 4.725e-3, thermal stress 741.6 MPa. With calibration constant C = 100000, Nf = 2772.58 cycles, safety margin 0.0277, evaluated as short thermal fatigue life, monitor cracks. Note C is a magnitude constant that must be regressed from material thermal fatigue tests (the tool default 1e5 is only an order-of-magnitude reference): if the fatigue ductility coefficient magnitude (about 0.2 to 1) is mistakenly used as C, Nf is only 0.02 cycles, clearly unreasonable.
map.C 与 β 怎么取？: How to choose C and beta?
map.β 通常在 −0.5~−0.7，金属材料常取 −0.6；C 是与材料、温度区间相: beta is usually minus 0.5 to minus 0.7, metals commonly take minus 0.6; C is a calibration constant related to material and temperature range, must be regressed from thermal fatigue test data (the tool default 1e5 is only an order-of-magnitude reference), otherwise the absolute life value will differ by orders of magnitude.
map.为什么用温度幅值而不是塑性应变幅值？: Why use temperature amplitude instead of plastic strain amplitude?
map.标准 Coffin-Manson 以塑性应变幅值为自变量；本工具用等效温度幅值作: The standard Coffin-Manson uses plastic strain amplitude as the independent variable; this tool uses equivalent temperature amplitude as a simplified substitute for quickly comparing different cooling schemes, but the absolute value is only reliable after calibrating C.
map.关于「快冷材料热疲劳」: About the Rapid Cooling Material Thermal Fatigue tool
map.快冷材料热疲劳寿命计算器基于 Coffin-Manson 低周疲劳公式，结合冷却: The rapid cooling material thermal fatigue life calculator is based on the Coffin-Manson low-cycle fatigue formula, combined with the cooling rate influence coefficient and material linear expansion coefficient, computes the thermal fatigue life of materials under rapid cooling, providing life reference for heat treatment processes and rapid cooling equipment design.
